mapper.select: SELECT history_id, record_type, record_id, aggregate_root_type, aggregate_root_id, parent_history_id, current_version FROM t_business_change_record WHERE parent_history_id IS NULL AND record_type='AGREEMENT' AND record_id IN (SELECT CAST(agreement_id AS CHAR) FROM t_agreement WHERE client_id = #{clientId} OR (local_partner_id IN #{partnerId} AND agreement_id IN (SELECT agreement_id FROM t_agreement_operating_entity WHERE entity_no IN #{entityNo}))) ORDER BY history_id
SELECT current_version FROM t_business_change_record WHERE record_type = #{rootType} AND record_id = #{rootId} AND parent_history_id IS NULL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_business_change_record (history_id, record_type, record_id, aggregate_root_type, aggregate_root_id, parent_history_id, current_version, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{row.historyId}, #{row.recordType}, #{row.recordId}, #{row.aggregateRootType}, #{row.aggregateRootId}, #{row.parentHistoryId}, #{row.currentVersion}, #{row.createTime}, #{row.updateTime})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM t_business_change_record WHERE record_type = #{rootType} AND parent_history_id IS NULL AND record_id IN #{rootId} ORDER BY history_id
